audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer describes the knockup backwards in four places: 'his E pillar knocks you into terrain for a Brittle stun' (early), 'Bounce you off terrain with his pillar knockback into a wall stun' (wants.foe[1]), 'His E pillar-dash closes your range and a wall bounce stuns you for free' (whys[2]), and 'a single pillar-to-wall stun from him' (late).
audit.why: Riot's text is explicit and the two abilities are the other way round. Volcanic Rupture (Q) is what creates the magma pillar. Searing Charge (E) knocks up 'if Ornn collides with terrain while charging' — the knockup fires around ORNN when HE hits the wall, it is not Mel being thrown into terrain. The practical instruction changes completely: you are not avoiding walls behind you, you are avoiding standing near the pillar he just placed and staying off the line between him and any terrain.
audit.corrected: Volcanic Rupture places the pillar; Searing Charge knocks up when Ornn himself collides with terrain, and his own pillar is the terrain he is aiming for.
sources: champ-data/_kits/ornn.json Q Volcanic Rupture and E Searing Charge descriptions

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3].text and the late text call Brittle a 'W passive' that 'shreds your resists'.
audit.why: Bellows Breath is an active — Riot's text: 'Ornn advances, breathing fire. Enemies hit by the final gout of flame become Brittle.' Call of the Forge God also applies it. I corrected the source of Brittle and removed the resist-shred claim rather than replacing it with a different mechanic: what Brittle actually does beyond being applied is not in the kit file, so asserting it either way would be speculation.
audit.corrected: Brittle comes from the final gout of Bellows Breath and is re-applied by Call of the Forge God; the resist-shred wording is gone.
sources: champ-data/_kits/ornn.json W Bellows Breath and R descriptions

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags that no Ornn ability is ever named, and the range comparison was never stated.
audit.why: Volcanic Rupture is 800 range; Mel's Radiant Volley is 950 and Solar Snare is 1000. Ornn's longest laning spell is shorter than both of hers, and Searing Charge is only 450. There is a real band where she can poke and he has no answer at all, and it was never quantified — the text only said 'stay outside his range'.
audit.corrected: Named all five abilities and stated the 800 vs 950/1000 band plus Searing Charge's 450 range.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer calls this FAVOURED, 4/10, with Mel ahead levels 1 through first item and the tldr 'Free stacking lane — every Q volley builds your execute while he farms politely'.
audit.why: The content layer's chart gives Ornn everything from level 3 onward and the matchup is 33.33%. The two layers cannot both be right, and the full one is the one that disagrees with the win rate.
audit.corrected: HARD, 7/10, carry threat 7/10; phases Skill / Skill / Ornn x5.
sources: scratchpad packet mel.json entry ornn (winRate 33.33, levelChart)

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns named Volcanic Rupture as 'matchup-defining' with no cooldown attached.
audit.why: Volcanic Rupture is 9/8.5/8/7.5/7 — short enough that it is never a window. The cooldown worth tracking is Searing Charge at 14/13.5/13/12.5/12, because that is the one that actually reaches her, and Call of the Forge God at 140/120/100.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the real numbers and the ranges that make them mean something.

edits.before: Treat Ornn like the one tank you don't get to bully. Your Q area poke and empowered autos do chip him, but he out-sustains it with raw tank stats and never has to walk into you — he just farms and waits for a pillar (E) or ram (W) angle. Your one good window is Level 2-3: land Q, then hold Solar Snare for the instant he steps up to charge, because that root is the only CC you have and you can't afford to whiff it. Never sit near a wall — his E pillar knocks you into terrain for a Brittle stun.
edits.after: Treat Ornn like the one tank you don't get to bully. Your Q area poke and empowered autos do chip him, but he out-sustains it with raw tank stats and never has to walk into you — he just farms and waits for a Searing Charge angle. Your one good window is Level 2-3: land Q, then hold Solar Snare for the instant he steps up, because that root is the only CC you have and you can't afford to whiff it. Never stand near a fresh Volcanic Rupture pillar — Searing Charge knocks up when Ornn hits terrain, and the pillar is the terrain he wants.

edits.before: This is where the lane slips away. Ornn self-itemizes his Forge, so he hits armor/MR breakpoints faster than a normal tank and your Q poke stops mattering against his effective HP. At 6 his R is the problem: a double knockup setup that ignores your max-range plan entirely — one R and you're airborne and Brittle-stacked before you can W or root. You only have one piece of CC and zero dashes, so once he lands a pillar-into-W or R on you, you're dead. Poke when he's forced to clear a wave, but stop trading the moment your Solar Snare is on cooldown.
edits.after: This is where the lane slips away. Ornn self-itemizes his Forge, so he hits armor/MR breakpoints faster than a normal tank and your Q poke stops mattering against his effective HP. At 6 his R is the problem: Call of the Forge God is a double knockup that ignores your max-range plan entirely — one recast and you're airborne and Brittle before you can W or root. You only have one piece of CC and zero dashes, so once he lands a charge or an R on you, you're dead. Stop trading the moment Solar Snare is on cooldown.

edits.before: You lose this outright late. Ornn's W passive makes targets Brittle, shredding your already-thin resists and amplifying every bit of burst that lands on your squishy frame — your infinitely-scaling passive doesn't matter if you're knocked up and deleted. His R double-knockup is a teamfight-starting button you have no answer to without Flash up, and you can't peel his front line off your carries. Your job shrinks to landing R detonations and Q from the very back; do not get caught alone, because a single pillar-to-wall stun from him is a death sentence.
edits.after: You lose this outright late. Bellows Breath makes you Brittle and Call of the Forge God re-applies it on a 140s cooldown, and your infinitely-scaling passive doesn't matter if you're knocked up and deleted. Call of the Forge God's double knockup is a teamfight-starting button you have no answer to without Flash up, and you can't peel his front line off your carries. Your job shrinks to landing R detonations and Radiant Volley from the very back; do not get caught alone, because one Searing Charge into a wall is a death sentence.
